      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mohamad Ahmadzadeh_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "Confusing, expensive, and financially dangerous for beginners I deposited €10 through SEPA for a simple test. The deposit arrived, but everything afterward was a nightmare. A basic purchase flow led me into opening a 9.7 EURC loan at 15% variable APR, with an opening fee and interest charged every four hours. The interface made the borrowed balance look like extra portfolio money. I only discovered later that I had 8.86x leverage and almost all my funds were locked as collateral."
